definition: Open WebUI is a self-hosted graphical user interface for interacting with artificial intelligence models, particularly large language models.
details: It can be used as a browser-based interface for locally hosted models through software such as Ollama and for remote models provided through OpenAI-compatible application programming interfaces (APIs). When used with locally hosted models, Open WebUI can operate entirely offline, while remotely hosted models can be accessed over the Internet through third-party providers. It provides a ChatGPT-style interface while allowing users to select among different models and providers.
